user.title: Yogasleep Dohm Connect
user.description: Hold the top button on the Dohm for ~5 seconds to make it discoverable, then select it.

name.title: Set up this Dohm
name.description:
Setting up {name}.

Choose one entity type, give it a name you would use for voice control, and optionally select an area. The entity type is fixed at setup; changing it later requires deleting and re-adding this integration.

data_description.name: For example: Bedroom Dohm
data_description.area: Optional. You can move it later without this being reapplied.
data_description.entity_type: Media player uses volume. Fan uses 10 speed steps. Only one entity is created. To change the type later, delete and re-add this integration. The entity_id changes (media_player.* or fan.*), so update automations and dashboards that use it.

abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured Dohm devices found. Hold the top button for ~5 seconds to make it discoverable, then try again.

menu_options.rebond: Clear the pairing and pair again

rebond.title: Clear the pairing and pair again
rebond.description:
Use this only for deliberate pairing recovery. No replies can also mean a slow link, poor range, or notification problems; check the logs before clearing a key.

This clears the key on the selected Bluetooth controller and requests a new bond. Hold the top button for about five seconds first. That can replace a working pairing.

If recovery reports partial completion or a controller change, follow its outcome and retry if needed. Ordinary failures are retried without clearing bonds.

abort.rebond_failed: Re-pairing did not complete. Check the logs for the error, and make sure the Dohm is powered and in range.
abort.rebond_unsupported: This Dohm is reached through an adapter that cannot clear pairings. A local Bluetooth adapter or an ESPHome proxy with the pairing feature enabled can do it.
